definitions.explanation: A ring given as a symbol of a marriage engagement. In Japan, diamond rings became standard from the mid-20th century under Western influence.

examples.japanese: {婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: He spent weeks choosing the engagement ring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ダイヤモンド→ダイヤモンド：11038_daiyamondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{婚約指輪|こんやくゆびわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左手|ひだりて}→左手：10975_hidarite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬指|くすりゆび}→薬指：16373_kusuriyubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はめて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She was wearing a diamond engagement ring on the ring finger of her left hand.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{婚約|こんやく}→婚約：02810_konyaku⟧ (engagement) and ⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧ (ring). Often abbreviated to エンゲージ⟦リング→リング：28765_ringu⟧ in casual speech, borrowing from English.
